**Step 1 — Scene:** A deli-meat and salad tortilla wrap cut into two halves, a bowl of mixed fruit, and a glass of orange juice.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** Estimated wrap plate diameter **22 cm**, area **380 cm²**; fruit bowl diameter **17 cm**, area **227 cm²**. The juice glass is approximately **7 cm** across.

**Step 3 — Items:** The wrap visibly contains tortilla, pink sliced deli meat, shredded lettuce and tomato; its exact filling and any sauce are uncertain. The fruit appears to include watermelon, cantaloupe, orange segments, apple and a dark grape or blueberry. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

**Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** The wrap is calculated as one composite food so its tortilla and overlapping fillings are not double-counted. Heights are average occupied heights, not maximum heights.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Two wrap halves, including visible fillings | 52% of plate | 198 × 2.2 = 436 ml | 0.65 | 283 | 190 |
| Watermelon | 22% of bowl | 50 × 2.3 = 115 ml | 0.60 | 69 | 30 |
| Cantaloupe | 12% | 27 × 2.2 = 59 ml | 0.60 | 36 | 34 |
| Orange segments | 8% | 18 × 2.0 = 36 ml | 0.65 | 23 | 47 |
| Apple pieces | 9% | 20 × 2.0 = 40 ml | 0.65 | 26 | 52 |
| Dark grape/blueberry | 1% | 2.3 × 1.5 = 3.5 ml | 0.70 | 2 | 60 |
| Orange juice | Glass cross-section ≈38 cm² | 38 × 5.2 effective fill depth ≈198 ml | 1.04 | 206 | 45 |

The fruit covers approximately **52% of the bowl’s full rim area**; the wrap covers approximately **52% of its plate**. The juice calculation uses an effective depth to account for the tapered glass.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **283 g of wrap**, **156 g of fruit**, and **206 g of juice** is plausible for the visible meal. Estimated total: **645 g and 787 kcal**, with the wrap filling and density being the largest uncertainties.
